device.name: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5070 Ti Laptop GPU

semantics: Every granularity-sized virtual slot maps the same single device-local physical allocation. Each lookup selects one tested virtual alias and a word offset inside the shared physical allocation. Physical backing and physical payload stay constant while alias count, virtual pitch and virtual span vary; both paths and both warp loads share the exact mapping for each case within a process.
scope_note: CUDA VMM granularity is a driver allocation property, not a claim about hardware page size or TLB organization.
